SELECT scans.zoneref AS site_code, sites.phasefactor AS historical_phase, AVG(scans.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(scans.pressratio) AS avg_compression_ratio
FROM scans
JOIN sites ON scans.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry
WHERE scans.scancount >= 11
GROUP BY scans.zoneref, sites.phasefactor
ORDER BY avg_compression_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
